definition: MISO 53 PROBE (not promoted; keeper decision with owner): the SOM-grounded coal offer REDESIGN the miso-52 residuals_note queued -- the gas-keyed sigmoid deep-discount premise adjudicated against the MISO IMM's measured conduct data and REPLACED for MISO. Redesign: coal sigmoids OFF (committed/econ/peak bid full measured F923 delivered SRMC), MISO COAL_* bands SOM-grounded (sub-1.0 committed/econ_low -> 1.00, retiring the inherited ERCOT-fitted 0.77 econ_low leak; >=1.0 rising shape kept), per-plant CAMPD fuel-free _mustrun band KEPT as the self-commitment representation (rule 19; the SOM start-share cannot dimensionally size capacity tranches). UNMASKED (rule 11, both pre-documented): CT_PEAKER over-run +16.9/+24.6 TWh (the de-leaked neutral-1.0 MISO CT committed hurdle -- its own comment predicted this; queued lane: CAMPD-grounded CT hurdle) and mean-LMP now OVERSHOOTS 2023/24 (+24.2%/+13.4%; 2025 -5.0% PASS) with C3b 0.311/0.304 (2025 0.102 PASS) -- the marginal setter lands on CT/coal-econ_high bands above the measured coal-SRMC anchor; the legacy >=1.0 band levels are the sanctioned rule-1 follow-up. COAL_BIT over-corrects low (-8.5/-11.5 TWh, loses mid-merit to unhurdled CTs). C3c 2024 PASSES (0.54x); 2023 33h vs 1h DA is the RT-like-dual representation gap (RT companion 30h); 2025 0.29x stays the RDC/ELMP scarcity lane. Determination NOT-YET (rubric v2.4). Adjudication record: docs/handoffs/miso-coal-offer-som-redesign-2026-07.md. Rule-20 zero-forcing ablation twin registered alongside; 2025 SOM publication is the rule-23 re-derive trigger.
market_story: Twin ~= main on every scored class (deltas <0.4 TWh): the SOM-grounded near-cost surface needs no merchant forcing. What real-market behaviour remains encoded: the fuel-free coal _mustrun band (kept in both runs) is the SOM-measured self-commitment -- regulated owners hold ~24% of coal capacity online regardless of price (must-run status on 53-56% of starts) -- and everything above it clears on measured delivered SRMC exactly as the IMM's mark-up ~ 0 conduct finding says it should.
